title: Kitchen Counter Orbit
premise: A porcelain mug, a brass teaspoon, and one orange share a honey-oak counter. Nobody is coming back for them. The camera does the visiting.
visual: Close still-life: glazed porcelain mug with coffee meniscus, brass teaspoon at a slight wrong angle, one navel orange, honey-oak grain running toward a cream plaster wall. Steam only — no hand, no window hero, no clock. Warm caged-bulb key, cool fill from the left. Real objects, employed, slightly too still.
motion: 48-second orbit, full 360, slight boom on a sine. Steam particles rise from the mug the whole time. The spoon yaws a few degrees and corrects. Light warmth ticks once, like a bulb on a dying ballast. Loop on the opening heading.
